sentences.en: The detachment was quickly forced to retire on its supports at the cross-roads, but here Prince Bernard firmly held his position; and by his skilful use of cover and the high standing corn he prevented the French gauging the weakness of the small force that barred their way.

sentences.en: As a teacher, besides the power of accurately gauging the character and capabilities of those who studied under him, he had the faculty of infecting them with his own enthusiasm, and thus of stimulating them to put forward their best efforts.

sentences.en: He had his fathers faculty for gauging public opinion, and estimating dangers, and though his more venturous temperament led him to press on far beyond the point at which the seventh Henry would have halted, he always stopped short on the hither side of the gulf.
sentences.vi: Anh ta có khoa của cha mình để đánh giá dư luận và ước tính nguy hiểm, và mặc dù tính khí mạo hiểm hơn của anh ta khiến anh ta gây sức ép vượt xa thời điểm mà Henry thứ bảy sẽ phải dừng lại, anh ta luôn dừng lại ở phía bên kia của vịnh.
